clauses.title: 3.1 Change rules only through the block API in edit.py. Never hand-edit files under views/.
3.2 After any rule change, run: render, then check --strict. Both must pass before the change is accepted.
3.3 A clause cluster (a root clause plus all its children) must stay contiguous. Inserting between a parent and its child is forbidden.
3.4 Every clause must carry a real purpose. Placeholder / shell clauses that say nothing are rejected.
3.5 Version numbers are bumped only in meta.json. Never edit a version string inside rendered views or clause text.
